notes.title: Operating frequency
notes.body:
Data is 5 bytes (10 bytes of BCD), little-endian. Digit order: byte-1 low nibble = 10 Hz, byte-1 high = 1 Hz, byte-2 low = 1 kHz, byte-2 high = 100 Hz, byte-3 low = 100 kHz, byte-3 high = 10 kHz, byte-4 low = 10 MHz, byte-4 high = 1 MHz, byte-5 low = 1 GHz (0 fixed on IC-7300), byte-5 high = 100 MHz (0-3).
Example: 14.257.000 MHz -> 00 00 57 42 01.

Commands 00 / 03 / 05 read or set transceive frequency; command 1C 03 reads the transmit frequency in Split.

notes.title: Operating mode
notes.body:
Data is 1-2 bytes.
Byte 1 - operating mode: 00=LSB, 01=USB, 02=AM, 03=CW, 04=RTTY, 05=FM, 07=CW-R, 08=RTTY-R.
Byte 2 - filter: 01=FIL1, 02=FIL2, 03=FIL3 (optional with commands 01 and 06; FIL1/default selected when omitted).

With command 06, mode changes in transceive are output.

notes.title: Band edge frequency settings
notes.body:
Band edge pair, one edge per data group:
  byte 1: edge number (01-1E = 1-30); not returned when reading by command 02
  bytes 2-6: lower edge frequency (5-byte BCD, same encoding as command 05)
  byte 7: separator 2D (fixed)
  bytes 8-12: higher edge frequency (5-byte BCD)

Command 02 reads band edge frequencies; commands 1E 01 / 1E 03 read or set numbered band edges.

notes.title: Scope waveform data
notes.body:
Outputs the waveform data to the controller
1 00 (Fixed)
2 Order of division data (Current): 01~11
3 Division number (Maximum): 11 (USB)
L  When sent through the USB port, the data is divided
by 11 and sent in sequential order.
L  The 1st data sends only the wave information (1 ~ 6)
without the waveform data (7).The 2nd or later data
sends the minimum wave information (1 ~ 3) with
waveform data (7).
4 Spectrum scope mode data:
• 00 = Center mode scope
• 01 = Fixed mode scope
• 02 = SCROLL-C mode scope
• 03 = SCROLL-F mode scope
5 Waveform information
The waveform information is different between
Center mode and fixed mode.
• In the Center mode:
Center frequency and span are sent.
See below for Frequency data, and the Scope
span settings (2 ~ 6) to the right.
• In the Fixed, SCROLL-C, and SCROLL-F modes:
Lower edge and higher edge frequencies are sent.
